text:
acme-support: Hey team — our finance contact at Acme says the daily export for 2026-02-14 contains 0 rows but the dashboard and invoice both show ~1.2M tokens for that day. S3 path: s3://redwood-exports/acme/2026-02-14/manifest.json. Can someone triage?
alejandra: ACK — can you paste the manifest and the export job id? also need the account id for the invoice (so billing can cross-check).
acme-support: job_id: export-20260214-acme-7f2a, account_id: acct_ace1234. manifest contents: `{ "files": [] }` (empty array). dashboard link: https://console/redwood/acct/acct_ace1234/usage?date=2026-02-14 shows 1,203,412 tokens. invoice_2026-02 shows charges consistent with that.
exports-bot: automated delivery log for export-20260214-acme-7f2a: STATUS=COMPLETED, uploaded_files=0, duration=48s, worker=export-worker-13.
raj: billing here — if export is empty we can't reconcile customer ledger vs invoice. Please flag ASAP. Any sign of backfill or manual deletion?
tim: looking at export-worker-13 logs around 03:12 UTC — I see `ERROR ShardCommit - no_shard_mapping for partition=14, outcome=skip_commit` and then `INFO ExportWorker - finished run, files_uploaded=0`. attaching minimal log snippet: ```2026-02-14T03:12:08Z export-worker-13 ERROR ShardCommit partition=14 msg="no_shard_mapping"```.
ingest-sre: that `no_shard_mapping` is from the aggregator checkpointing change we rolled 2026-02-14 02:50 UTC. We had a short window where shard->node mapping could be temporarily absent while the new checkpoint migrated. It looks like this worker skipped committing the aggregated file as it believed the partition had no mapping. raw events are intact in ledger-events topic.
alejandra: ok — so root cause likely aggregator checkpoint migration race causing zero-file export. We need to recompute the day for acct_ace1234 and re-run export.
raj: will that change invoice numbers? Accounting needs notice if usage changes. Also we should surface a delta estimate before reissuing invoices.
tim: we can recompute from ledger-events using the daily-aggregation job. repro/run steps (internal):
```
# run on infra-recompute
python tools/recompute_day.py --account acct_ace1234 --date 2026-02-14 --source ledger-events --out s3://recomputed/acme/2026-02-14.csv --run-id repair-20260214-1
```
Then validate token sum with `scripts/token-sum.py` and upload to customer export bucket.
acme-support: ETA for that? customer is asking whether they'll see differences on invoice.
ingest-sre: estimate 1-3 hours to recompute + validation (depends on partition lag). I'll take ownership. Kicking off job now, will post job id and intermediate checksums.
kai: can we also add an alert on zero-file manifests for exports where dashboard usage > threshold (e.g., >1000 tokens) so this is caught earlier? add a JIRA for exports-alerts.
alejandra: created ENG ticket INF-8721 for zero-manifest alert + add retries on shard mapping missing.
exports-bot: started recompute job repair-20260214-1, worker=repair-07, input_partitions=16.
raj: accounting note — please tag the recompute with `billing-impact` and leave a short summary in the ticket so we can track invoice adjustments if needed.
ingest-sre: recompute finished. produced file s3://recomputed/acme/2026-02-14.csv size=4.3MB, token_sum=1,203,398 (close to dashboard). uploading to export staging and rerunning manifest generator.
exports-bot: new manifest uploaded s3://redwood-exports/acme/2026-02-14/manifest.json -> `{ "files": ["part-0000.csv"] }`
alejandra: verified token_sum vs dashboard — 1,203,412 dashboard vs 1,203,398 recomputed (diff 14 tokens, within tokenizer variance). Marking export as repaired.
raj: thanks — will reconcile and confirm whether invoice stays same (14 token delta is negligible). Accounting notified, no invoice reissue needed.
acme-support: forwarding update to Acme. they asked for repro summary — going to paste the log snippet and the steps.
alejandra: summary to include: root cause (checkpoint migration race -> shard mapping absent -> worker skipped commit), remediation (recompute from ledger-events + validation), follow-ups (INF-8721 to add zero-manifest alert + retry on missing shard mapping), owner: ingest-sre.
kai: assign INF-8721 to eng-alerting and cc ingestsre.
alejandra: closing thread — thanks everyone :thumbsup: if anything else pops up we can reopen.
